trigger: Canal Park battle. IED flips an MRAP; Ruiz is pinned under the door.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The MRAP is on its side, burning. Ruiz is under the blast door, leg trapped, rifle out of reach.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Kowalczyk. Hah. Of course. Say again your intentions. Over.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You jam a pry bar under the hinge. It moves an inch. Two. She drags herself free.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Here. My ID. Gets you through Blatnik once, maybe. Don't thank me. Go.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: And Kowalczyk. Bradley's covering the pier. Go under the crane, not around it.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You take the rifle. Behind you, someone else will find her. Someone.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It's quick. It doesn't feel quick.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The lift bridge control house is fifty meters ahead. Searchlights sweep the canal.
